description: A barber's pole turns in a bracket over a doorway breathing steam into the street. The window is tiled halfway up in green and lettered LATHER & LYE · CUT, SHAVE, HOT WATER, with HOT WATER twice the size of the rest, because it's the part that sells. Condensation runs down the inside of the glass in slow, patient lines.
name: Lather & Lye
